headline: HEG Advanced Materials updates exchange on composite scheme results
hook: HEG Advanced Materials shares latest financials
summary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited has communicated the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on behalf of HEG Graphite Limited, which has been renamed as HEG Limited following a composite scheme of arrangement. The filing provides statutory financial disclosures for the newly structured corporate entities. Retail investors should review the standalone and consolidated financials to gauge earnings performance post-restructuring.
why_it_matters: Post-merger financial numbers dictate near-term stock valuation.

headline: HEG Advanced Materials reports name change of resulting company
hook: HEG Graphite renamed to HEG Limited
summary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited informed the exchange that HEG Graphite Limited has officially changed its name to HEG Limited following a composite scheme of arrangement. This update reflects corporate structuring for shareholders and market participants tracking the entity. Retail investors holding the stock should note the new corporate name for future portfolio tracking and exchange records. The change is part of ongoing corporate reorganization processes.
why_it_matters: Portfolio records need updating with the new company name.

headline: HEG Advanced Materials shares jump 8% on fresh orders and demerger plans
hook: Graphite business carved out into HEG Graphite
summary: HEG Advanced Materials saw its stock surge 8 percent following announcements of fresh orders and a structured demerger scheme. Under this plan, the company's graphite electrodes business will be carved out into a separate entity named HEG Graphite. This new entity is slated to list as a standalone company by the end of October. Retail investors holding the stock will see corporate restructuring as the core driver of value unlocking.
whats_next: Listing of HEG Graphite by October-end
why_it_matters: Restructuring creates a standalone listed graphite play for shareholders
